items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 12:1
items.html:
Explains the fourth and fifth Partzufim of AK, called MA and BON of AK, and it contains four matters: A. The coming into being of MA, BON, and AK. B. Coarseness is called vapor, and its five discernments are called: forehead, eye, ear, nose, mouth. C. That in the coarseness of phase one, and the root of AK, phase four became joined, and therefore there was in them a coupling by striking. D. Inner and outer MA and BON of AK.

The coming into being of MA and BON of AK
And after Partzuf SAG was completed, the surrounding light again returned and refined the coarseness of phase two to phase one, and the upper light, which does not cease illuminating, struck it and brought out ten Sefirot at the level of ZA, called Partzuf MA of AK, and it extended into Rosh, Toch, Sof. And this Partzuf is called the world of Nekudim. And in it too there was a refinement of the screen as in the preceding Partzufim of AK, except that here the refinement is regarded as the breaking of the vessels, because it was mixed with the coarseness of phase four, as written in its place (as the Rav wrote in Part Four, item 36), and the coarseness of the root remained in it. And behold, the upper light, which does not cease illuminating, struck that coarseness of the root, and ten Sefirot were extended at the level of Malchut, which are regarded as Partzuf BON of AK. And it is called the world of Atzilut and BYA, as written in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 12:2
items.html:
Coarseness is called vapor. And its five discernments are called forehead, eye, ear, nose, mouth
And behold, the matter of the extension of the five Partzufim of AK, one from another, called Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA, and BON, has been explained well. And know that these five discernments of screens are called the five vapors, since the coarseness in the screen is called by the name vapor. In such a way, that Partzuf Galgalta of AK came out from the vapor of the mouth, which is phase four. And Partzuf AB of AK came out from the vapor of the nose, which is phase three. And Partzuf MA of AK came out from the vapor of the eyes, which is phase one. And Partzuf BON of AK came out from the vapor of the forehead, which is the discernment of Keter, meaning the root of coarseness.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 12:3
items.html:
In the coarseness of phase one, and the root, of AK, phase four became joined, and therefore there was in them a coupling by striking
And one should not ask, is it not that the vapor of the eyes, which is phase one, its coarseness is thin and does not suffice for a coupling by striking (as the Rav wrote in Part Three, item 80), and all the more so the vapor that comes out from the forehead, which is the coarseness of the root, that it does not suffice for a coupling by striking. And the matter is, that before the coupling was made on the vapor of the eyes, something new was corrected there, called the second restriction, which is the secret of the ascent of phase four to Bina, and because of this, phase one and the discernment of the root became coarse through it, until they sufficed for a coupling by striking, as written in its place. And the fact that the world of Nekudim, which came out from the eyes, is called SAG, and the world of Atzilut is called the new MA, which came out from the forehead, is because there are two levels there, male and female, since in the world of Nekudim there remained a mark of clothing from phase two, which joined with the mark of coarseness from phase one, and the level of SAG, called male, was extended upon them. And likewise in the world of Atzilut there remained a mark of clothing from phase one, which joined with the coarseness of the discernment of the root. And from their joining together, the level of MA, called male, was extended upon them, as written in its place. But from the discernment of the mark of coarseness, which is the level of the female, there was only the level of BON. And therefore this MA is called the new MA, to exclude it from the level of MA that is in Nekudim, which is the old MA, prior to this MA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 12:4
items.html:
Inner and outer MA and BON of AK
However, these two levels, MA and BON, which came out in Nekudim and in the world of Atzilut, are no longer considered to be MA and BON of AK itself, but rather to be the externality of MA and BON of AK. And this is because they were corrected in the second restriction, whereas AK as a whole is the first restriction. Except that these two levels, MA and BON, were included in the internality of AK, because they passed through it and became fixed in it, since there is no absence in the spiritual. And this MA and BON, which were included in AK, are called MA and BON of AK, or the inner MA and BON of AK, upon which the world of Nekudim and the world of Atzilut clothe.
